rationale: Pivot to the new knn_classifier family — first non-parametric trainer in the registry. Default HP (k=100, distance, manhattan, pca=0) already beats both baselines (avg_ann -3.3% vs random_topk -30.2% / rule_only -27.8%) AND the prior logistic_elastic_net default (-8.8%) AND produces a clean W2 pass (+79.5% ann / 40.9% WR). HP space is wide and untouched: n_neighbors ∈ {25,50,100,200,400}, weights, metric, pca_components ∈ {0,16,32,64}, leaf_size — the bias-variance dial alone has 5 unexplored points, and pca_components > 0 (collapsing 96-d redundant aggregates) is the most promising untested move.
